senses.gloss:
भोक्तव्य भोक्तव्य, भोक्तृ, &c. See p. 713,
col. 3.

भोक्तु-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. the Inf.), wishing
to enjoy or eat, &c.

भोक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, an enjoyer, eater, feeder
[cf. प्रातर्-भ्˚]; enjoying, eating; possessing; one
who employs or makes use of; one who feels or
experiences (joy, sorrow, &c.), feeling, experienc-
ing; (ता), m. a possessor; a king, ruler; a husband;
a lover.
—भोक्तृ-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being and
enjoyer or eater, the being a possessor or feeler;
enjoyment, possession; perception.
—भोक्तृ-शक्ति,
इस्, f. the faculty of the soul as the enjoyer and pos-
sessor of nature.

भोक्ष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being about to enjoy
or eat.
